The Standing Committee on Industry, Innovation and Science has commenced an inquiry into the current state of the Australian tyre industry, and any challenges and opportunities for the industry within the context of a circular economy. The inquiry was adopted on 5 November 2025, following a referral from the Minister for Industry and Innovation, and the Minister for Science.

The Committee requests submissions responding to the terms of reference by Friday, 23 January 2026. For more information about making a submission, go to our Making a submission to a Parliamentary Inquiry page.

Please note that contributions to the inquiry are not automatically published on the website. Each contribution is processed by the Secretariat and considered by the Committee to determine whether it will be accepted as a submission and authorised for publication.

Committee Secretariat contact:

Committee Secretary
House Standing Committee on Industry, Innovation and Science
PO Box 6021
Parliament House
Canberra ACT 2600

Phone: 02 6277 4114
iis.reps@aph.gov.au
